metadata.title: Maachor Muror Khar | Fish Head Curry | Assamese Style
metadata.description:
Machoor Muror Khar or Assamese style fish head curry is a simple and rustic Assamese recipe commonly prepared the countryside of Assam. 

Fish heads preferably head of large carp fishes are split in half, marinated in salt and turmeric and are deep fried. This deep fried fish head is boiled and softened with kola khar or liquid alkali obtained from banana stem. 
The dish is usually served with a drizzle of raw mustard oil which adds on to the flavour and opens up all the senses. 

This delicious dish from Assam is a good accompaniment for steamed rice.
